mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.course_id, c.course_name, t.title, t.requirement, t.template_file, t.start_time, t.deadline, t.deadline_policy, t.grace_days, t.finish_mode, t.group_min, t.group_max, t.score_mode, t.total_score, t.weight_check, t.status, t.publish_time, t.cancel_reason, t.archive_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, (select count(1) from edu_task_participant p where p.task_id = t.task_id) as participant_count, (select count(1) from edu_task_participant p where p.task_id = t.task_id and p.submit_status in (2, 3)) as submitted_count, (select count(1) from edu_task_participant p where p.task_id = t.task_id and p.submit_status = 2) as pending_count from edu_task t left join edu_course c on c.course_id = t.course_id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_task (course_id, title, requirement, template_file, start_time, deadline, deadline_policy, grace_days, finish_mode, group_min, group_max, score_mode, total_score, weight_check, status, publish_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{requirement}, #{templateFile}, #{startTime}, #{deadline}, #{deadlinePolicy}, #{graceDays}, #{finishMode}, #{groupMin}, #{groupMax}, #{scoreMode}, #{totalScore}, #{weightCheck}, #{status}, #{publishTime}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update edu_task set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_task_score_item (task_id, item_name, weight, max_score, sort_no, remark) values
(#{taskId}, #{it.itemName}, #{it.weight}, #{it.maxScore}, #{it.sortNo}, #{it.remark})
mapper.select: select resource_id from edu_task_resource where task_id = #{taskId}
select id, task_id, target_type, target_id from edu_task_exhibit where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_task_exhibit (task_id, target_type, target_id) values
(#{taskId}, #{it.targetType}, #{it.targetId})
mapper.select: select distinct cs.user_id from edu_class_student cs where cs.is_current = '1' and cs.class_id in ( select cc.class_id from edu_course_class cc where cc.course_id = #{courseId} union select c.class_id from edu_course c where c.course_id = #{courseId} and c.class_id is not null ) order by cs.user_id
select m.group_id from edu_group_member m join edu_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id where g.task_id = #{taskId} and m.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_task_participant (task_id, user_id, submit_status, overdue_flag) values
(#{taskId}, #{uid}, 0, '0')
mapper.update: update edu_task_participant p set p.group_id = ( select m.group_id from edu_group_member m join edu_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id where g.task_id = p.task_id and m.user_id = p.user_id limit 1 ) where p.task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_task_participant where task_id = #{taskId}
select count(1) from edu_task_participant where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from edu_task_participant where task_id = #{taskId} and submit_status = #{submitStatus}
select count(1) from edu_submission where task_id = #{taskId} and status in (2, 3, 4)
select count(1) from edu_score where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 1

select p.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as userName, pr.student_no as studentNo, p.group_id as groupId, g.group_name as groupName, p.submit_status as submitStatus, p.overdue_flag as overdueFlag, s.submission_id as submissionId, s.status as submissionStatus, s.submit_time as submitTime from edu_task_participant p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id left join edu_user_profile pr on pr.user_id = p.user_id left join edu_group g on g.group_id = p.group_id left join edu_submission s on s.task_id = p.task_id and s.user_id = p.user_id where p.task_id = #{taskId} order by pr.student_no, p.user_id
